scope: Completed draft-design goal: nine named complex apps plus the demonstrated CanDecide extension. Not executable application acceptance or completion of the historical migration.

CanDecide.independent_reviews: Primitive and app source/target reviews complete; material repairs applied; writer released.
CanDecide.source_check: Saved supported-syntax projection passed. Full source is not accepted by the current prototype; projection omits judgment, sequences and polling and substitutes delivery types.

acceptance.requirements_source_and_desired_target: Present for all ten apps; proposed imports remain explicit contracts.
acceptance.business_workflows: Company-specific permissions, bounded work, success/rejection/recovery, evidence and human decisions remain authored.
acceptance.shared_mechanics: Judgment including runtime choices, associated progress, typed full invocations, corpus and gallery have normative contracts and actual source/target witnesses.
acceptance.ui_and_examples: Shared shell/component contracts and inline translations; meaningful table and sequence expectations retained.
acceptance.review: Focused independent reviews and applied repairs, with named evidence and no unresolved material finding from their bounded scope.
acceptance.ownership: All focused creative writers/reviewers released their paths; final integration owned by root.

limits: Syntax and static correspondence are not runtime correctness, security or performance proof. Production implementation and the older migration remain separately owned.
